Subject: RE: Intro + Redwood x CloudBridge next steps

Hi Marissa / Camila,

Thanks again for the intro call this morning — great to hear about Redwood's hosted and dedicated options. CloudBridge is excited about exploring a marketplace listing + a joint technical integration.

Quick recap from our side:
- We're interested in a private marketplace listing and a streamlined onboarding path for our ISV customers.
- Key technical questions: network/topology requirements for Private deployment (VPC peering or private endpoints), SSO/KMS expectations, and any recommended quantization/instance types for cost-sensitive deployments.

Next steps: we'd love to schedule a technical deep dive/demo with one of your SEs to align on integration points and timelines. Alex and I are available next week on Tue 12/22 (10–12 PT) or Wed 12/23 (1–4 PT).

I attached a short CloudBridge integration overview and a preliminary scope doc for context.

Thanks,
Samir

Hi Samir — great to meet you both today and thanks for sending the materials.

I'm looping in Laura (solutions engineer) and Camila (partner lead) so we can run the technical deep dive and cover marketplace requirements. Laura — would you be able to run a 60-minute session that covers: deployment options (Private/VPC), KMS/HSM integrations, and recommended perf/cost profiles for CloudBridge's typical customer workloads? We'll also leave 15–20 minutes for Q&A and next-step coordination.

Samir — Tue 12/22 10–12 PT works for us. I can do 10:30–11:30 PT if that fits — otherwise we can take 11–12 PT. If you'd prefer Wed 12/23, we have an opening 1:30–2:30 PT. Please confirm a slot and I'll send a calendar invite with an agenda.

Proposed agenda (high level):
- 10m: Introductions + goals
- 25m: Technical walkthrough (deployment/networking/KMS)
- 15m: Marketplace onboarding & procurement touchpoints
- 10m: Action items & timeline

Also, could you confirm whether we'll need any NDA or compliance documentation shared ahead of the call? We can prep SOC2 artifacts if needed.

Cheers,
